entity.summary: Self-custody cryptocurrency wallet ecosystem spanning SafePal hardware wallets, a mobile application, and a browser extension.
entity.notes: SafePal is modeled as a hybrid wallet ecosystem because its current lineup includes hardware wallets plus mobile and browser-extension software.

products.summary: Air-gapped SafePal hardware wallet in the current supported hardware lineup.
products.notes: SafePal S1 is listed in SafePal's current first-party hardware-wallet store with a current price and active purchase action. WLR therefore records sales_status=on_sale while retaining the separately reviewed launch/support boundaries.

products.summary: SafePal S1 Pro hardware wallet in the current supported hardware lineup.
products.notes: SafePal S1 Pro is listed in SafePal's current first-party hardware-wallet store with a current price and active purchase action. WLR therefore records sales_status=on_sale while retaining the separately reviewed launch/support boundaries.

products.summary: Bluetooth-capable SafePal X1 hardware wallet in the current supported hardware lineup.
products.notes: SafePal X1 is listed in SafePal's current first-party hardware-wallet store with a current price and active purchase action. WLR therefore records sales_status=on_sale while retaining the separately reviewed launch/support boundaries.

products.summary: SafePal mobile wallet application and hardware-wallet companion interface.
products.notes: SafePal's first-party 2019 history establishes an active SafePal App release lineage before the later software-wallet upgrade: a July 2019 DEX announcement refers to the SafePal App and an upcoming official App/firmware version, while a September 2019 progress update states that nine App versions had already been released. SafePal separately records May 2020 as the launch of the SafePal Software Wallet capability. WLR therefore records the App's initial launch as 2019 at year precision and treats the 2020 software-wallet milestone as a later capability expansion, not the App's initial release.

products.summary: SafePal self-custody browser-extension wallet for supported desktop browsers.
products.notes: Current first-party download page explicitly lists Chrome and Edge distribution; launch date is left unset pending a separate reviewed launch source.

events.title: Customer order data exposure disclosed
events.description: SafePal disclosed exposure of customer order information affecting approximately 40,000 customers. SafePal stated that private keys and seed phrases were not compromised.
events.notes: This is a customer/order-data privacy incident, not a wallet private-key, seed-phrase, or key-storage compromise. WLR does not infer compromise of wallet software, hardware, or signing keys from this disclosure.

events.title: SafePal S1 opened for sale
events.description: SafePal states that the S1 hardware wallet opened for sale on May 27, 2019, marking the commercial release of its first hardware wallet.
events.notes: The release date uses SafePal’s first-party progress update. Current SafePal history independently places the official S1 launch in May 2019.

events.title: SafePal Extension Wallet officially launched
events.description: SafePal announced the official launch of its browser extension wallet on August 19, 2022.
events.notes: The historical launch announcement listed Chrome, Firefox and Microsoft Edge. Current supported-browser status is governed separately by current distribution evidence and is not inferred from this 2022 event.

events.title: SafePal X1 Bluetooth hardware wallet officially launched
events.description: SafePal records the official launch and open-source release of its X1 Bluetooth hardware wallet in September 2023.
events.notes: Month-level precision is retained because the contemporaneous 2023-09-13 CEO letter announced the launch while still referencing preorder availability; no exact commercial-release day is inferred.

events.title: SafePal S1 Pro released through official channels
events.description: SafePal announced on September 7, 2023 that the S1 Pro was ready for distribution through official SafePal channels and available to order.
events.notes: The release date uses SafePal’s direct first-party S1 Pro release announcement rather than a later retrospective.

events.title: SafePal App added self-custody software-wallet capability
events.description: SafePal officially released SafePal Lite inside the SafePal App, allowing users to create or import self-custody software wallets in addition to using the App as a companion for SafePal hardware wallets.
events.notes: This event records the software-wallet capability release, not the initial SafePal App launch. First-party SafePal posts show that the App already existed in 2019.

events.title: SafePal App released in 2019
events.description: SafePal's first-party 2019 history establishes an active mobile-app release lineage, including an official App version announcement and a later statement that nine App versions had already been released.
events.notes: Year precision only. The July 2019 source concerns a DEX-capable official App version and already refers to the SafePal App; it is not treated as the exact initial App launch day. The May 2020 Software Wallet milestone is modeled as a later capability expansion rather than the initial App release.

evidence.title: Security Update
evidence.notes: First-party SafePal disclosure used for the customer-order-data exposure and the explicit boundary that private keys and seed phrases were not compromised.

evidence.title: SafePal Download Center
evidence.notes: Current first-party distribution page confirming the active SafePal App, SafePal Extension Wallet, and supported SafePal S1, S1 Pro, and X1 hardware-wallet lines.

evidence.title: Our Response To The Security Findings From Kraken Security Labs
evidence.notes: First-party SafePal source describing SafePal as a decentralized wallet and establishing the project as founded in 2018.

evidence.title: SafePal Progress Update
evidence.notes: First-party SafePal update explicitly states that SafePal S1 was open for sale on May 27, 2019.

evidence.title: The SafePal difference, now available on Chrome: Introducing SafePal Browser Extension Wallet
evidence.notes: First-party SafePal announcement explicitly identifies August 19, 2022 as the official launch of the SafePal browser extension wallet.

evidence.title: About SafePal — Our History
evidence.notes: First-party SafePal history records the official launch and open-source release of the X1 Bluetooth hardware wallet in September 2023.

evidence.title: SafePal releases the S1 Pro
evidence.notes: First-party SafePal release post states that the S1 Pro was ready for distribution through official SafePal channels and available to order.

evidence.title: SafePal Lite Software Wallet is now ALIVE
evidence.notes: Primary SafePal announcement for the 2020-05-11 release of decentralized software-wallet functionality inside the existing SafePal App. It explicitly distinguishes this from the earlier hardware-wallet companion App.

evidence.title: Pre-announcement: Trade on DEX, with SafePal
evidence.notes: First-party SafePal article referring to users trading through the SafePal App and announcing an official App/firmware version for July 2019. Used to establish the 2019 App release lineage, not as proof that the announced DEX version date was the initial App launch day.

evidence.title: SafePal Progress Update
evidence.notes: First-party SafePal progress report stating that nine App versions and three firmware updates had already been released. This directly establishes an active SafePal App release lineage in 2019 while leaving the exact first public store-release day unresolved.

evidence.title: SafePal Products — Hardware Wallets
evidence.notes: Current first-party SafePal store lists S1, X1 and S1 Pro with prices and active Buy Now purchase actions. Used only for current sales status.
